title: Rooftop Retreat/10 min to Broadway/Modern/Sleeps 4
description:
Enjoy your stay in Music City in this gem located in trendy East Nashville! Located just one exit from the Opry Mills Outlet and The Grand Ole Opry and a short Uber ride from downtown Nashville. 

The building where the condo is located includes two rooftop terraces. One is located on the 2nd floor and one is located on the top floor. They are both accessible by elevator or stairs.  

This place is sure to meet or exceed your expectations for a great stay in Nashville!

The space
This space includes a kitchen, bathroom, bedroom with a queen bed and it also has a sofa bed, which is also a queen. 

The kitchen is fully equipped with basic cooking materials and utensils to eat with. There is also a coffee bar with a coffee maker and Expresso machine. 

The bathroom has a shower dispenser filled with body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. 

The parking lot can be accessed through the backdoor, but it only locks from the inside. To lock it you must hold the door handle up and turn the knob. 

There are two rooftop terraces on the property. One is located on the 2nd floor, the other one is located on the 3rd floor. They can be accessed by elevator or stairs.

Guest access
The back door only locks from the inside. If you are leaving the building to explore the city, please leave through the door with the keypad lock.
